name: Family Affair Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: overnight campers get the N (full hookup) and C (water/electric) sections and a primitive field, roughly 50 of some 300 numbered sites on the operator's map; the rest are leased seasonal sites with decks and sheds. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site (read 2026-10-21): Overnight Camping page sells nightly sites (50-amp full hookups in N section, water/electric in C section, primitive sites; phone reservations, one-night deposit) with a 2026 Overnight Rate Schedule PDF (night/week/month rates, no application); seasonal page is a separate $2,000 May-Sep lease; operator site map (scanned 2026-08-31) shows N + C overnight sections (~50 sites, >1 in 10) among ~300; Esri imagery at 42.1666,-79.7768 shows open gravel pull-through pads by the pavilions that fit 23 ft; Google Maps 4.4 (251 reviews), open, phone 814-722-5636 -> real transient RV campground beside a large seasonal section; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21 audit: the only water is a small (~100 m) catch-and-release fishing pond, no swimming (operator amenities page). Operator site map + Esri imagery at 42.1666,-79.7768: the overnight N-section pull-throughs sit ~30-40 m north of the pond across the campground loop road and a lawn with a tree row (a developed strip, no open apron); the C overnight section is ~300 m NW by the ball field, nowhere near water; the pond-ringing V/'Pond' sites hold trailers of the seasonal section. No transient RV pad at the waterline -> not waterfront (no view tier exists for a pond).
fees_source: https://www.familyaffaircampground.com/_files/ugd/031509_860eccf2cd964b14a569ac6f0c2c0da4.pdf ('Overnight Schedule fee' download on /overnight-camping; '2026 Overnight Rate Schedule', PDF dated 2026-01-17, read 2026-10-21): standard nightly rate for 2 adults + dependent children: electric & water $70, electric/water/sewer $75, primitive (no hookups) $50; week $420-450, month $1,568-1,680; visitors $5/day, $7 overnight (not mandatory for a family of two). Holiday packages: Memorial Day / July 4th / Labor Day 3-night minimum ($260-280 hookups), Jamboree Fri+Sat $170-185.

booking.note: Memorial Day (Fri-Mon), July 4th (Thu-Sun) and Labor Day (Fri-Mon) sold only as whole 3-night packages paid in full at booking; the late-July Jamboree weekend sold as a Fri+Sat pair. Reservations by phone, one-night nonrefundable deposit.

booking_source: 2026 Overnight Rate Schedule PDF (URL in fees_source), read 2026-10-21
flags: nightly_low uses the $70 water/electric site; primitive (no hookups) sites are $50 but the operator doesn't say whether they take RVs (the primitive field on the map looks tent-oriented).
Transient share is read off the operator's section layout (N + C sections ~50 of ~300 numbered sites, counted from the scanned map), not a stated count; it clears 1 in 10 comfortably either way.
Two phones on the operator site: the page header shows 814-725-8112, while the footer, the 2026 rate PDF and Google Maps all give 814-722-5636 (used).
Season: opens May 1 for 2026; the seasonal lease runs May 1 - Sep 30 (overnight close date not stated).
Pin is the overnight N-section pull-throughs by the pavilions; the C overnight section is ~300 m NW near the ball field.
